payload.title: Slots vs backends
payload.body: A slot is WHAT (brain, voice, vision). A backend is HOW (Candle, llama.cpp, ORT). The same slot can run on different backends depending on the model format.

payload.title: Embedder vs reranker tradeoff
payload.body: Embedders are fast but approximate (cosine similarity). Rerankers are slow but precise (cross-attention). Use both: embedder finds 50 candidates, reranker picks the best 10.

payload.title: Smaller models, faster answers
payload.body: A 0.6B model answers in milliseconds. A 14B model takes seconds. For background tasks (summarizing, formatting), the small model wins on speed.

payload.title: Three databases, one purpose
payload.body: Turso stores structured data (messages, settings). DuckDB stores analytics (how you use the app). The knowledge graph stores relationships (what connects to what). Each does one thing well.

payload.title: Streaming vs buffered
payload.body: Responses stream token-by-token so you see them as they generate. This isn't faster — it just feels faster. The total time is the same either way.
